input_law: all 1722 ordered distinct nonidentity pairs of the fixed 43-point E(F47)
crt_policy: the existing full-law centered CRT curve stream, with no reduced-relation filtering
selector: for every local gate curve and point pair independently, enumerate k residues 0..11 satisfying P+kQ=O; intersect the 7 and 11 sets for every centered CRT curve; union across that pair's CRT curves
coefficient_domain: k=1..41, the unique reduced coefficient for every distinct nonidentity target and generator on the 43-point group
analysis_only: after the local selector is frozen, compute the true reduced k by exhaustive group additions and compare it with the local union; never use true k to select a curve or residue
records: one row per source pair with local residue union, candidate set size, true k, and all exclusions; one row per CRT candidate with local residue set; exact raw hashes
resource: complete finite local enumeration on all 32256 centered CRT candidates; no rational relations or wall-time comparison
claim_boundary: quantifies ambiguity of this finite local selector; cannot imply a rational relation or a discrete-log speedup
